Read the short privacy policy ↗

GOOD TO KNOW

Before your
first set.

Which app should I choose?

Choose OnlyBody for bodyweight-focused training, or OnlyWeights for free weights, cables and machines. You can use both. Their workouts and history are stored separately.

Do I need equipment for OnlyBody?

Many exercises need no equipment. Others use a pull-up bar, support or similar equipment. Each exercise lists what you need, and you can filter the library by equipment.

Can I change a workout as I go?

Yes. Reorder exercises or replace one before you start its sets. Changes to an active session apply to that session; your saved workout stays as it was.

When can I download the apps?

OnlyBody and OnlyWeights are coming soon for iPhone with iOS 26 or later. Verified App Store links will appear here at launch.

Is there a subscription?

The current apps have no subscriptions or in-app purchases. Launch pricing will be shown on the App Store.
